meaning.hi: मृत्यु प्राणियों का हृदय है, मृत्यु परम तत्व में एकाकार होती है

meaning.en: earth is food, water is its eater
meaning.hi: पृथ्वी अन्न है, जल उसका भक्षक है

meaning.en: water is food, light is its eater
meaning.hi: जल अन्न है, प्रकाश उसका भक्षक है

meaning.en: light is food, wind is its eater
meaning.hi: प्रकाश अन्न है, वायु उसकी भक्षक है

meaning.en: wind is food, space is its eater
meaning.hi: वायु अन्न है, आकाश उसका भक्षक है

meaning.en: space is food, the senses are its eaters
meaning.hi: आकाश अन्न है, इन्द्रियाँ उसकी भक्षक हैं

meaning.en: the senses are food, mind is their eater
meaning.hi: इन्द्रियाँ अन्न हैं, मन उनका भक्षक है

meaning.en: mind is food, intellect is its eater
meaning.hi: मन अन्न है, बुद्धि उसकी भक्षक है

meaning.en: intellect is food, the unmanifest is its eater
meaning.hi: बुद्धि अन्न है, अव्यक्त उसका भक्षक है

meaning.en: the unmanifest is food, the imperishable is its eater
meaning.hi: अव्यक्त अन्न है, अक्षर उसका भक्षक है

meaning.en: the imperishable is food, death is its eater
meaning.hi: अक्षर अन्न है, मृत्यु उसकी भक्षक है

meaning.en: death becomes one with the highest reality
meaning.hi: मृत्यु परम सत्य में एकाकार होती है

words.sanskrit: bhagavan yo 'yam vijnana-ghana utkraman sa katarad va sthanam dahati

meaning.en: venerable one, what does this dense mass of understanding burn in departure
meaning.hi: भगवन्, प्रस्थान में यह सघन बोध किस स्थान को जलाता है

words.sanskrit: pranam dahati apanam vyanam udanam samanam vairambham

meaning.en: it burns the life-breath, downward, pervading, rising, balancing, encompassing breaths
meaning.hi: यह प्राण, अपान, व्यान, उदान, समान, वैरम्भ को जलाता है

words.sanskrit: mukhyam antaryamam prabhanjanam kumaram shyenam shvetam krishnam nagam dahati

meaning.en: it burns the chief, inner-controlling, scattering breaths and the youthful, hawk, pale, dark, serpent presences
meaning.hi: यह मुख्य, अन्तर्याम, प्रभञ्जन और कुमार, श्येन, श्वेत, कृष्ण, नाग को जलाता है

words.sanskrit: prithivy apas tejo vayv akasham dahati

meaning.en: it burns earth, water, fire, wind, space
meaning.hi: यह पृथ्वी, जल, अग्नि, वायु, आकाश को जलाता है

words.sanskrit: jagaritam svapnam sushuptam turiyam cha dahati

meaning.en: it burns waking, dreaming, deep sleep, and the fourth state
meaning.hi: यह जागृति, स्वप्न, सुषुप्ति, और चतुर्थ को जलाता है

words.sanskrit: imam lokam param cha lokam dahati

meaning.en: it burns this world and the world beyond
meaning.hi: यह इस लोक और परलोक को जलाता है

meaning.en: it burns every world beyond worlds, right conduct and wrong conduct
meaning.hi: यह लोकालोक को, धर्माधर्म को जलाता है

words.sanskrit: abhaskaram amaryadam niralokam atah param dahati

meaning.en: it burns the sunless, boundless, lightless realm beyond that
meaning.hi: यह सूर्यहीन, असीम, प्रकाशहीन क्षेत्र को जलाता है

words.sanskrit: mahantam dahati avyaktam dahati aksharam dahati mrityum dahati

meaning.en: it burns cosmic intelligence, the unmanifest, the imperishable, death
meaning.hi: यह महान बुद्धि, अव्यक्त, अक्षर, मृत्यु को जलाता है

meaning.en: death becomes one with the highest reality
meaning.hi: मृत्यु परम सत्य में एकाकार होती है

meaning.en: this Subala-seed Brahman teaching should not be given to one without peace
meaning.hi: यह सुबाल-बीज ब्रह्मोपनिषद अशान्त को न दी जाए

meaning.en: not to one without a son, not to a non-student
meaning.hi: न पुत्रहीन को, न अशिष्य को

meaning.en: not to one who has not dwelt a year and night under a teacher
meaning.hi: न एक वर्ष गुरु के पास न रहे व्यक्ति को

meaning.en: not to one whose family and character are unknown
meaning.hi: न जिसका कुल-शील ज्ञात न हो उसे

meaning.en: should never be taught to the unworthy
meaning.hi: अयोग्य को कभी न सिखाई जाए

words.sanskrit: yasya deve para bhaktir yatha deve tatha gurau

meaning.en: whose devotion to god equals devotion to the teacher
meaning.hi: जिसकी ईश्वर में भक्ति गुरु जैसी हो

words.sanskrit: tasyaite kathita hy arthah prakashante mahatmanah

meaning.en: to such a great soul these meanings, once spoken, shine forth
meaning.hi: ऐसे महात्मा के लिए ये अर्थ प्रकाशित होते हैं

words.sanskrit: iti etan nirvana-anushasanam iti veda-anushasanam iti veda-anushasanam

meaning.en: this is the teaching on liberation, this is the Veda's teaching
meaning.hi: यही मोक्ष का उपदेश है, यही वेद का उपदेश है
